caption:
The video captures a nighttime scene over a calm pond. A broad cluster of golden-white firework bursts, three overlapping spherical peony-like explosions, already fills the dark sky above a low city skyline dotted with lights. Throughout the view the cluster persists, its radial streaks lengthening and drooping slightly downward while the bright core points drift apart, slowly increasing the apparent diameter of the burst as the outer glow softens toward the edges and the smoke haze lingers below.

The overhead fireworks and the distant skyline are mirrored as a shimmering reflection on the water. This reflection deforms in step with the expanding burst above, its bright patches stretching vertically across the surface. A dark paddlewheel-like device sits in the water on the right with its own reflection. A small floating structure is visible mid-frame. The horizon framing stays constant, with no pan, tilt, or zoom evident. The skyline lights and the water objects remain fixed in position. The fireworks continue to spread without fading during the view.
